note: Hand-built scenario library. Each scenario is one moment: a start state and one event, so a question asks about a single time. S1-S4 come from Lab 3; S5 was added for requests that start from sunset. 'probe' marks a bug-class boundary (Brackenbury et al., 2019); 'sets' is the condition the scenario's event makes true; 'repair' is the rule proposed when no reading gives the wanted outcome there.

scenarios.label: home since 17:00, dark at 18:00
scenarios.text: You have been home since 17:00. At 18:00 it gets dark.
scenarios.question: Should the hallway light come on at 18:00?

scenarios.label: arrive at 19:00, after dark
scenarios.text: It is dark. You arrive home at 19:00.
scenarios.question: Should the hallway light come on when you arrive?

scenarios.label: arrive at 15:00, daylight
scenarios.text: It is daylight. You arrive home at 15:00.
scenarios.question: Should the hallway light come on when you arrive?

scenarios.label: light on, leave at 23:30
scenarios.text: The hallway light is on. You leave home at 23:30.
scenarios.question: Should the hallway light turn off when you leave?

scenarios.label: out at 18:00 when it gets dark
scenarios.text: You are out. At 18:00 it gets dark.
scenarios.question: Should the hallway light come on while you are out?
